newsitem.title: UK: British director desperate over figures lost in US.
newsitem.headline: British director desperate over figures lost in US.

text.p: The creator of two of Britain's best-loved screen stars -- animated models Wallace and Gromit -- appealed on Monday for the safe return of the plasticine figures he left in the back of a New York taxi cab.
Nick Park, whose madcap inventor Wallace and his dog Gromit starred in the Oscar-winning films "The Wrong Trousers" and "A Close Shave", said he was desperate to get his characters back.
"I've lost my two best pals," Park told BBC radio. "It was the first time I'd taken my eyes off them for five seconds."

The nine-inch (22cm) figures were left in a box in the trunk of a taxi taking Park to Manhattan for a promotional tour. Park said the model of Wallace and Gromit on a red motorcycle and sidecar cost more than 6,000 pounds ($9,000) to make.

"We've been on the phone all day, faxing all the police departments and cab companies in New York, sending out an "artist's identikit' of the characters and saying "have you seen these film stars?'," Park said.
Park ran along the Manhattan street in teeming rain in pursuit of the cab after it dropped him off at a hotel but could not attract the driver's attention.
"Wallace and Gromit are my babies and they are lost somewhere in Manhattan," Park said.

A New York taxi driver interviewed by BBC radio said Park should easily be able to track down the cab from the identification number which is supposed to be given on hailing a cab and paying the fare.
There were copies of Wallace and Gromit on their motorbike but the missing models were originals, Park said.
"I know there are more important things in life, but I think that it's because they are the original models from the film and they were so expertly made, with precision," he said.
He said he was steeling himself for the worst.
"I have sort of resigned myself to the fact that I might not see them again -- but at the same time, one can always hope," Park said. ($1=.6298 Pound)
